note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Whether the effect of the decision is maintained or suspended during the review is a SUPPLIED DATUM (finalState) printed on the filter tag; the scene never explains it, never states a suspension doctrine, a date or a time limit, and never judges the decision or the appeal. The calendar marks no date. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes (lane captions), outcomes (the two data texts), actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are editable.
